description: This file contains the OrderBuilder class used for constructing Order objects with default or custom values for unit testing purposes within the eShopOnWeb application.

classes.name: OrderBuilder
classes.description: A test utility class to create Order instances with predefined values for unit testing.

methods.name: OrderBuilder
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the OrderBuilder with default CatalogItemOrdered and sets up initial Order object.

methods.name: WithDefaultValues
methods.description: Creates an Order with default buyer ID, address, and a list containing one OrderItem.

methods.name: WithNoItems
methods.description: Creates an Order with no OrderItems.

methods.name: WithItems
methods.description: Creates an Order with a specified list of OrderItems.
